blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Four of eleven member states of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean), along with the United Arab Emirates (UAE), are set to join a proposed regional oil stockpiling initiative to strengthen energy security and reduce supply disruptions, according to Department of Trade and Industry Sec. Ma. Cristina Roque. Roque said Singapore, Indonesia, Malaysia, and the Philippines had agreed to participate in the pact, while the UAE had also expressed interest in storing oil inventories in countries with available storage facilities.
